name: Dead Mines [Alpha]
desc:
Your cherished grandfather gifts you a coin. A rare coin. On your way home, you stumble, and the coin falls deep into a... cave? So, you hop into a rickety old mine cart and begin your unsafe journey to retrieve your coin. But that's not all that awaits you at the end...

Game is new, leave a like to support!

How to Play❓
🚋 Ride the Minecart with Friends
🪓 Mine Crystals with Your Pickaxe
💰 Sell Loot to the Merchant
⚔️ Defeat Mobs and Survive the Depths
💀 Can You Escape the Dead Mines?

Update 02: 3/30/2025
-Game balancing and minor changes
-Codes have been added to the lobby!
-"The Vault" now spawns at 3000m... can you get in?

More coming soon. Let us know what you want to see in the next update!
